name: Baby proofing
summary: How new expat parents baby-proof Singapore flats — condo window and balcony risks, outlet covers, soft-edge installs, and installer vs DIY kit trade-offs.
body:
High-rise living changes baby-proofing priorities: window stops, balcony door latches, and furniture anchors matter as much as cabinet locks. Installers who know condo rules avoid drilling mistakes that anger MCSTs.

## Typical jobs
- Window and sliding-door restrictors
- Corner guards and TV / bookshelf anchoring
- Fridge / oven / toilet locks
- Stair gates for maisonettes
- Post-install walkthrough for crawler vs toddler stages

Landlord consent may be required before drilling.

## How to choose
Prefer installers who stock humidity-tolerant adhesives and explain removable options for rentals. Ask for a room-by-room checklist, not only a product catalogue. Confirm whether removal at move-out is included.

## Practical tip
Do the crawl yourself at baby eye level before booking. Most missed hazards are low drawers and dangling blind cords.
